title: Provide Firebase accounts and optional PostgreSQL backups
body:
## Problem

Families need to recover boards and saved media after reinstalling or moving devices without giving up local offline use. Optional Firebase sign-in enables consent-based backups to the selected server; guest libraries stay local and sign-out keeps downloaded boards.

## Requirements and acceptance

- Preserve optional, explicit account/server consent; guest/offline SQLite/IndexedDB and local media remain local.
- Provide account lifecycle/session isolation and durable PostgreSQL backups with revision conflicts, asset integrity, complete snapshot restoration, quotas and recoverable deletion.
- Preserve board/media restoration and local data through offline failures/reconnect; test consent and recovery against the actual base.
- Account-only extraction must not activate or depend on the deferred ChatGPT grant feature; preserve original PR11, PR24 and their evidence while coordinator evaluates the independent continuation.
- No provisioning, provider activation, legacy migration, release/deployment or TestFlight work. Real-provider/native validation remains separate.

## Implementation plan

The pre-created account plan covers Firebase identity and optional PostgreSQL backup. Use the independent account-only implementation from current master; deferred ChatGPT grants are excluded. Preserve the earlier stacked implementation and its evidence; no active PR20 dependency remains.

[Exact original requirements, plan and history](https://github.com/MChartier/agentic-development-workflow/blob/be7f2a00cbf9ced12d4b1a7a52f28e455695d7e3/issue-template-migration/little-say-19-original.md).
